title: Chapter 109 Who Is Wang Shuo
content:
Chapter 109 Who Is Wang Shuo

"What are you doing? You're running away before you even fight the boss. I look down on you. Didn't we just kill a lot of bosses?"

Dongfang Ling broke free from Fang Kai's hand and glanced at him with contempt. At the same time, she was eager to try.

She hadn't faced the golden boss head-on yet!

"Miss, this is different! Let's get out of here!" Fang Kai hid his inner fear. Although he tried his best to cover it up, he still said it in an anxious tone.

He had participated in countless battles. He had only seen his father kill a boss of this level once.

That time, he was deeply impressed. At that time, he couldn't even get close.

"No, I want to meet this toad." Dongfang Ling once again showed her temper.

The more she was told not to do something, the more she wanted to do it.

"Sister Ling'er, how about we withdraw first?"

Xu Qing was also a little nervous and whispered to comfort her.

"Don't be afraid, it's okay!"

Dongfang Ling was obviously a little confident.

Just as several people were arguing.

Brunei was less than 100 meters away from Wana Village.

He jumped directly onto the inner wall of Wana Village.

The light wall with a durability of up to 10,000 only lasted for a few breaths before it was directly crushed.

Fortunately, it lasted for a few breaths, so the people hiding inside had time to escape, and no large number of casualties were caused.

However, 4 people were still crushed to death.

The village-level administrative center was also half-collapsed.

Even the ground was sunken nearly one meter deep.

Suddenly, a burst of dust flew.

Strangely, no shouting was heard.

Everyone.

At this time, they were silent.

Brunei glanced at the humans around him.

It was like a toad looking at a ladybug.

With a roll of his tongue, the militia captain Hua Tianxiong was swallowed directly into his mouth.

He didn't even call for help.

It was not until this time that people's exclamations and cries were mixed together.

Wang Shuo was also shocked at this time.

"Human taste is really delicious."

Brunei rolled up three more people and swallowed them into his mouth, then he showed a satisfied look.

"Who is Wang Shuo?"

"Before I eat you, I still want to get to know you!"

The voice of the toad was like a bell, resounding in everyone's ears, vibrating the eardrums a little painful.

At this time, everyone was shocked.

"Our lord was actually named by this toad."

Some people turned their heads unconsciously to look at Wang Shuo, wanting to see what their lord had in mind that was worthy of the toad's attention.

This look directly exposed Wang Shuo's position.

Wang Shuo came back to his senses and thought to himself that it was not good.

"Are you Wang Shuo?" Brunei showed a strange look, and his sharp eyes seemed to see through Wang Shuo's soul.

Brunei did this.

First, to avenge his descendant Wen Tai, who was separated by who knows how many generations.

Second, he wanted to confirm Wang Shuo's identity. After all, this was a task that the Ironblood Lord had specifically assigned him.

This task was naturally agreed to by Lord Zach.

As long as Wang Shuo was killed, he would have exceeded the target for this beast attack on the village.

If Wang Shuo was not killed, then at least 90% of the player territories in Changping County would have to be destroyed to be considered excellent.

Moreover, killing Wang Shuo would help him befriend the Ironblood Lord, which would be good for his tribe.

As for the life and death of other beasts, or even the silver boss, what did it have to do with him!

"I am." Wang Shuo saw that he could no longer escape, so he had to admit it.

"Okay, you can go and die."
